summary: Real COCO GT, prediction-only decoding, honest metric scaling, hash-locked development-to-evaluation transition, and completed outputs pass integrity checks. Development selected alpha=0 for every arm, so the 600-image run is an exact identity check and not a nonzero efficacy or shuffle-control test.

gt_provenance.details: Decoder receives only model outputs. COCO annotations and bbox50 mappings are used only in post-decoding measurement; official COCOeval provides task metrics.

score_normalization.details: Logit RMS is intervention amplitude scaling, not an evaluation score. Metrics use COCOeval, GT-area fractions, or IoU; no metric is normalized by prediction maxima or means.

result_existence.details: 160-image development, 600-image evaluation, and task receipts are COMPLETE. Hash-bound summaries and 600 per-image files per arm existed; LOCAL_VERIFICATION.json is PASS with 28 verified receipt entries and 12,246 exact-area records.

dead_code.details: Decoder, nonzero development arms, selection, official evaluation, paired analysis, and post-hoc transfer code are active. Main nonzero random-shuffle path is unexercised because selected alpha is zero, an explicitly disclosed limitation.

scope.details: One model; 160 enriched development images; 600 previously explored val images; no nonzero locked evaluation, effective shuffle control, model seeds, second model/dataset, or pristine test. Development CIs are pointwise and post-selection descriptive.

claims.claim: The predeclared development gate selected zero and this concrete decoder did not earn promotion.
Nonzero relative reranking reduces same-neighbor occupancy but shifts error to background on the development sample.
The 600-image evaluation independently tests nonzero relative, geometry, and random interventions.
Exact input-grid foreground cardinality implies exact image-space area or GT coverage.
All neighbor information or CCL is ineffective.
